boundary_analysis.headline_support_rule: Top-axis lists require at least two eligible families; single-family estimates remain in the complete boundary table but are not headline claims.
boundary_analysis.label_scope: Only finite-feature attempted rows labeled completed or failed; timeout and not_attempted rows are excluded.
boundary_analysis.stratification: AUC is computed within each binding O32 canonical generation-protocol family and averaged with equal family weight.
boundary_analysis.uncertainty: Deterministic grouped bootstrap over family AUCs, 2000 replicates, percentile 95% intervals.

definitions.boundary_strength: Two times the absolute deviation of equal-family-weight completed-vs-failed AUC from 0.5; descriptive association, not a causal or predictive claim.
definitions.broad_family: The top-level problem-instance directory grouping, retained only as a display field.
definitions.canonical_family: The binding O32 generation/import-protocol family used for all grouped boundary statistics and uncertainty.
definitions.completed: The accepted G48 campaign records a completed solver execution for this task-method pair.
definitions.failed: The accepted G48 campaign records an attempted execution that failed; this is not a timeout.
definitions.layout_coordinates: A deterministic two-dimensional layout aid; distances are approximate and neither clusters nor axes are claims about physical topology or difficulty.
definitions.not_attempted: No execution result exists for this task-method pair; this is a coverage fact and never a failure label.
definitions.timeout: The accepted campaign records an attempted execution terminated by its time limit.

embedding.method: deterministic classical multidimensional scaling of the block-aware distance matrix

feature_space.gauge_exclusion_rationale: Gauge-flagged values remain first-class catalog features but are excluded from this distance metric because exact-degeneracy values are not reproducible under the pinned pipeline.

jw_encoding_coverage.mask_semantics: All fifteen selected JW values are null for each listed task; masks are not imputed.

feature_space.jw_encoding_rationale: JW statistics are Hamiltonian features under the shipped declared representation; solver-mechanism priors do not determine eligibility.
feature_space.pair_distance: square root of the mean squared whitened distance over blocks shared by each task pair
feature_space.scaling: median-centered robust IQR with population-standard-deviation fallback
feature_space.selection_rule: Current T0-T2 model-eligible columns, including JW encoding statistics and excluding all gauge-flagged columns from distance construction.
feature_space.within_block_reduction: PCA whitening to at least 95% variance within each exact-applicability logical block
